body:
### 🟢 Approval recommended No active review issues are reported for the revert restoring automatic entity selection on the maintenance page and Home summary. **No open issues** 🎉
What changed in this PR Reverts #55610, removing maintenance-page-specific entity hiding from the Home Assistant frontend and restoring automatic entity selection for the maintenance page and Home summary. **Changes:** - Removes visibility editing and maintenance preference loading, saving, and subscriptions. - Removes the visibility wrapper card, related configuration fields, filtering helpers, and editor translations. - Updates tests to reflect entity selection without maintenance-specific exclusions. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | `test/​panels/​maintenance/​strategies/​maintenance-view-strategy.test.ts` | Removes tests for hidden entities and visibility editing. | | `test/​common/​entity/​entity_filter.test.ts` | Restores filtering tests without explicit exclusions. | | `src/​translations/​en.json` | Removes maintenance visibility-editor strings. | | `src/​panels/​maintenance/​strategies/​maintenance-view-strategy.ts` | Restores direct tile generation without visibility overrides. | | `src/​panels/​maintenance/​ha-panel-maintenance.ts` | Removes editing controls and maintenance preference handling. | | `src/​panels/​lovelace/​strategies/​home/​home-overview-view-strategy.ts` | Removes maintenance exclusions from summary generation. | | `src/​panels/​lovelace/​strategies/​home/​home-dashboard-strategy.ts` | Stops forwarding maintenance visibility preferences. | | `src/​panels/​lovelace/​strategies/​helpers/​entity-visibility.ts` | Deletes the visibility wrapper helper. | | `src/​panels/​lovelace/​create-element/​create-card-element.ts` | Removes visibility-card lazy loading. | | `src/​panels/​lovelace/​cards/​types.ts` | Removes visibility-card and summary exclusion fields. | | `src/​panels/​lovelace/​cards/​hui-home-summary-card.ts` | Calculates maintenance status without page-specific exclusions. | | `src/​panels/​lovelace/​cards/​hui-entity-visibility-card.ts` | Deletes the visibility-editing wrapper card. | | `src/​panels/​home/​ha-panel-home.ts` | Removes maintenance preference fetching and subscriptions. | | `src/​data/​frontend.ts` | Removes maintenance data types and queued-save helpers. | | `src/​common/​entity/​entity_filter.ts` | Removes explicit entity-exclusion support. |
Review effort: Balanced
